newsitem.title: USA: Redbook sales seen up 0.3 pct two weeks Jan.
newsitem.headline: Redbook sales seen up 0.3 pct two weeks Jan.

text.p: Traders and analysts in the U.S. Treasury market said the Redbook Retail Sales Index is expected to show a 0.3 percent rise on a seasonally adjusted basis for the first two weeks of January when the data are reported later Tuesday.
Talk about the Redbook Index followed a 0.2-percent increase in the BTM/Schroders month-to-date index of U.S. retail sales on a seasonally adjusted basis.
Lynch, Jones & Ryan Inc will report the Redbook Index at 1455 EST/1955 GMT.
